text:
maria_sales: FYI, on a call with AcmeHealth POC right now — their mobile app is throwing JSON parse errors during SSE stream. Browser shows "Unexpected end of input" when responses are long.

alex_se: Is the client using EventSource or an SDK polyfill? Any sample chunk output? :thinking_face:

maria_sales: They said EventSource polyfill on older Android WebView. We captured a failing session and see partial JSON in the first data: line.

jon_oncall: Can you paste the server/edge log window + request id so I can correlate?

maria_sales: Pasted logs for req id abcd-POC (redacted):

maria_sales: ```
192.0.2.11 - - [21/Mar/2026:16:12:31 +0000] "GET /v1/stream?id=abcd-POC HTTP/1.1" 200 0 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
edge-proxy: upstream write error: broken pipe
runtime: chunk sent bytes=512
runtime: chunk sent bytes=512
runtime: chunk sent bytes=128
edge-proxy: flushed 3 chunks
edge-proxy: client closed connection
```

maria_sales: we also captured the client-visible SSE sequence: 

maria_sales: ```
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel"

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"lo, wor"}}]}

data: [DONE]
```

maria_sales: first data line is cut mid-object (missing closing braces) which breaks the JSON.parse on their polyfill.

lee_devex: Two likely causes: intermediary proxy splitting inside JSON blobs or the client polyfill assuming one JSON per data: block. Workarounds: server emit complete JSON per data or client buffer multiple data lines then parse.

alex_se: Check Content-Type and any proxy buffering flags (e.g., X-Accel-Buffering, proxy_buffering). Also confirm whether any CDN or customer-side proxy could be ttfb-chunking.

maria_sales: Acme traffic goes through CloudFront + their corporate proxy. They insisted on demo before signature; streaming reliability is a gating item. They also asked whether Dedicated would help.

alex_se: Short answer: Dedicated reduces multi-tenant noise and predictable tail latency, but it won't magically change how SSE fragments cross TCP frames. For the POC, we can patch the SDK client to resiliently reassemble partial JSON, and on the server side we can avoid splitting objects across data: events.

jon_oncall: From the logs it looks like the client closed the connection and we had one upstream write error. No runtime 5xx. That suggests either the client gave up or a middlebox terminated early. Can we get a packet capture from the failing device?

tara_cs: Acme also asked about cost to trial Dedicated for two weeks to see if it improves their UX. I'll prepare a trial voucher and short cost delta note. Also collecting answers for their security questionnaire around KMS/HSM for Private deployment.

lee_devex: I can ship a patched mobile SDK today that buffers data: lines and tries to JSON.parse only when it sees a complete object (or when a max buffer size is reached). Low friction for them to install for the POC.

alex_se: Server-side mitigation: add a guard in the streaming emitter so we only emit a data: event when we have a complete JSON object (or we include sequence numbers for fragments). We can do a conservative buffer of ~1KB to avoid latency impacts.

maria_sales: They want a demo tomorrow. ETA on SDK patch + staging deployment?

lee_devex: SDK patch ready in ~3 hours. I'll open a staging deploy.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by lee_devex for branch fix/sse-reassembly -> env: staging

jon_oncall: Next steps summary:
- maria_sales: request PCAP from failing mobile session (if they can)
- Acme dev: try patched SDK once staging URL provided
- lee_devex: share SDK patch + small reassembly snippet for their engineers
- alex_se/jon_oncall: implement server-side guard for full-object emissions and test under proxy conditions

maria_sales: I'll coordinate with Acme to get the pcap and schedule the demo. Thanks team! :pray:
